Instead of clear-cut chances, the opening 45 minutes were highlighted by the referee's whistle. Estudiantes de Rio Cuarto saw Tomas Gonzalez and Alejandro Cabrera enter the book early on. Instituto Cordoba had to adapt to an early tactical shift when Raul Lozano was replaced by Gonzalo Gonzalez in the 35th minute. Despite the intensity, neither side could break the deadlock before the half-time whistle. The Second Half Surge The game transformed immediately after the restart. In the 49th minute, Giuliano Cerato found the back of the net to give Instituto Cordoba the lead. The atmosphere intensified as yellow cards were shown to Gustavo Abregu and Matias Tissera as both teams battled for control. The decisive blow came in the 73rd minute when Leonel Mosevich struck a goal, expertly assisted by Giuliano Cerato , doubling the advantage and leaving the visitors shell-shocked. Final Drama and Victory Just as Estudiantes de Rio Cuarto attempted to regroup, disaster struck again. In the 75th minute, an own goal by Marcos Ledesma effectively ended the contest, putting the result beyond doubt. A flurry of substitutions followed, with Martin Garnerone and Javier Ferreira entering the fray for the visitors, while Instituto brought on fresh legs like Jonas Acevedo to see out the game. After five minutes of stoppage time, the final whistle blew, confirming a comprehensive victory for the home side on a memorable night in Cordoba.
